appearance.identity: Blue-gray curved square tower with a genuinely open trapezoidal crown and narrow top bridge.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Compact SWFC exterior preserves the original curved six-sided envelope, real crown aperture, split piers, upper bridge, curtain-wall bands and representative lobby canopies. Detailed original source remains reproducible.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original227144-triangle19082184-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.

geographic.notes: Inspected architect skyline and oblique facade pictures confirm the curved square prism, blue-gray curtain wall and open trapezoidal crown. Preserve original492m height,58m structural square and aperture between439/474m. Existing mapped upper parts establish the crown ridge orientation and exact-QID anchor. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the Lujiazui tower and road context; structural square remains smaller than the mapped roughly60m envelope. Off-footprint PMTiles point[-60,0]0.2921m sets approximate ground contact; center8.3629m contains coarse urban imprint. Bounded preview correction retains raw terrain separately. Exact cutback curvature, observation beam elevations, facade schedule and lobby thresholds remain authored approximations; wider retail podium excluded.
